newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 11.784 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 11.784 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Friday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.77 percent and 17.62 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 11.784 billion levs of T-bills and the ministry approved all the bids.
The issues were offered with no par values or minimum acceptable prices set in advance by the ministry.
Bids received 8,913.3 million levs 2,870.6 million levs
Avg price of bids 96.37 pct 85.02 pct
Bids approved 8,913.3 million levs 2,870.6 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.77 pct 17.62 pct
